title: MWS — Demographics
description: Administrative and demographic fields recorded at recruitment: birth year, recruitment year, age, region of residence, and which questionnaire version the participant completed.

RYOB.title: Year of birth
RYOB.$comment: Source states no explicit valid range for this field. Upper bound 1953 is derived from stated source facts: RAGE's own minimum (48) and the latest recruitment year across all questionnaire versions (2001) -- 2001-48=1953. Lower bound 1880 is an agent-decided plausibility floor, since the source states no maximum age -- D010.

RYSUBMIT.title: Year of recruitment into the MWS
RYSUBMIT.$comment: Range 1996-2001 combines the source's own per-version year metadata (Blue 1996-1998, Aqua 1997-2001, Other 1997-2000) into one bound -- source-derived, not invented -- D011.

RAGE.title: Age at recruitment
RAGE.$comment: Source states a valid range of From=48 only (To is blank/unstated). Minimum 48 is source-stated; maximum 120 is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling -- D012.

RREGION.title: Region of residence at recruitment
RREGION.description: Derived field; UK regional breast-screening-style catchment areas as recorded at recruitment.

RQTYPE.title: Questionnaire version completed
RQTYPE.description: A code determining which version of the recruitment questionnaire the participant completed. Other fields' source-stated Availability columns (Aqua/Blue/Other) reference this same three-way split.
